about: Pictures chosen here instead of in the console (guideref.js applies them once for each new mark): 'official' shows the sign's official drawing, 'ai' the made picture. 2026-10-10 review: C23.3 lost its red bar and E16.1 shows no merge in the made pictures; E16.2, E22.4, E69.9, F34.2, F34.3, A72 and E19 showed prove.dk's pictures; M54's «official» drawing is the UNESCO emblem, not the national-park crown.
